# Copilot instructions for BezCatalyst

## Project purpose
This repository is a GitHub profile repository for the user "BezCatalyst". Its main purpose is to present identity, current interests, collaboration goals, and contact information through the README shown on the profile page.

This is not a product application, service, or library codebase. The repository should stay lightweight and content-focused.

## Working expectations
- Prefer changes to `README.md` or other small supporting profile files.
- Keep the tone personal, concise, and professional.
- Maintain valid GitHub-flavored Markdown and keep formatting readable on profile pages.
- Use emoji, headings, and short bullets sparingly to preserve clarity and visual balance.
- Do not introduce frameworks, build tooling, package manifests, or app architecture unless the user explicitly asks for it.

## Repository conventions
- Treat the repo as a profile/landing page, not a feature project.
- Respect the original author voice and avoid adding unrelated product complexity.
- When updating profile text, keep it aligned with the user’s goals: learning AI automation, systems design, local business AI workflows, and professional networking.
- Preserve contact links and profile sections when editing content.

## Validation
- Validate markdown structure and readability rather than running application tests.
- If content changes are made, briefly confirm the result still reads well as a GitHub profile entry.

## When generating changes
- Keep edits minimal and targeted.
- Favor polished profile copy over speculative feature work.
- If a request would turn this repo into a software project, clarify that the repository is currently a profile README and ask whether the user wants a separate project scaffold instead.
